"""GET /api/briefing — the home screen: what changed since the last run, what's new, what waits for the PM, and a
pulse per car × market. A composition of existing tables; no writes."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict

from fastapi import APIRouter

from api import labels as L
from api.deps import db
from api.queries import (PRIORITY_RANK, best_first, conflict_info, current_wave, effective, evidence_gaps, loads,
                         parse_key, proposals, requirement_summaries, target_obj, target_rows, verbatim_base)
from bmw_req.pipeline.waves import WAVES
from bmw_req.portfolio import all_targets

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["briefing"])

FEED_MAX = 25
# Nested actions written by accept/reject_proposal or by "also accept the AI priorities" — the parent event stands for them.
NESTED_PREFIXES = ("Accepted AI proposal #", "Accepted new AI requirement #", "Rejected new AI requirement #",
                   "Accepted the AI suggestion with the decision")
DECISION_ACTIONS = ("set_status", "set_priority", "accept_proposal", "reject_proposal", "override_gate", "challenge")


def _tone_priority(old: str | None, new: str | None) -> str:
    if old in PRIORITY_RANK and new in PRIORITY_RANK:
        return "up" if PRIORITY_RANK[new] < PRIORITY_RANK[old] else ("down" if PRIORITY_RANK[new] > PRIORITY_RANK[old] else "neutral")
    return "neutral"


def _target_from_entity(entity_id: str):
    if ":" not in entity_id:
        return None
    try:
        return target_obj(*parse_key(entity_id.split(":", 1)[1]))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _movers(conn, run_id: int | None, prev_id: int | None, titles: dict) -> tuple[list, dict]:
    stats = {"priority_changes": 0, "risers": 0, "fallers": 0}
    if not run_id or not prev_id:
        return [], stats
    snaps = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in conn.execute("""SELECT run_id, requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, score, priority
                             FROM score_snapshot WHERE run_id IN (?, ?)""", (prev_id, run_id)):
        snaps[(r["requirement_id"], r["vehicle_model_id"], r["market_code"])][r["run_id"]] = r
    causes = {r[0]: r[1] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT entity_id, rationale FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'rescore' AND run_id = ?", (run_id,))}
    movers = []
    for (rid, v, m), by_run in snaps.items():
        old, new = by_run.get(prev_id), by_run.get(run_id)
        if not old or not new or old["score"] is None or new["score"] is None:
            continue
        delta = new["score"] - old["score"]
        if old["priority"] != new["priority"]:
            stats["priority_changes"] += 1
        if delta >= 0.5:
            stats["risers"] += 1
        elif delta <= -0.5:
            stats["fallers"] += 1
        if abs(delta) >= 0.05 or old["priority"] != new["priority"]:
            movers.append({"req_id": rid, "title": titles.get(rid, {}).get("title"), "target": target_obj(v, m),
                           "score_old": round(old["score"], 1), "score_new": round(new["score"], 1),
                           "delta": round(delta, 1), "priority_old": old["priority"], "priority_new": new["priority"],
                           "cause": causes.get(f"{rid}:{v}×{m}")})
    movers.sort(key=lambda x: (-abs(x["delta"]), x["req_id"]))
    return movers[:8], stats


def _feed(conn, props: list[dict], titles: dict) -> list[dict]:
    items = []
    for p in props:
        if p["status"] == "superseded":
            continue
        kind, title_req = p["kind"], p["requirement_title"]
        chip = None
        if kind == "priority":
            title = f"AI suggests {p['proposed_value']} for {p['target']['label'] if p['target'] else p['requirement_id']}"
            chip = {"text": f"{p['old_value'] or 'not set'} → {p['proposed_value']}",
                    "tone": _tone_priority(p["old_value"], p["proposed_value"])}
            actor = "pipeline.scoring"
        elif kind == "new_requirement":
            title, chip, actor = f"New requirement drafted: {title_req}", {"text": "new", "tone": "up"}, "pipeline.derive"
        elif kind == "extend":
            title = f"Merge suggested into {p['requirement_id']}: {title_req}"
            chip, actor = {"text": "merge", "tone": "neutral"}, "pipeline.derive"
        elif kind == "link_finding":
            title = f"Evidence link suggested ({p['field'].replace('finding:', 'F')}) for {p['requirement_id']}"
            chip, actor = {"text": "evidence", "tone": "neutral"}, "pipeline.challenge"
        else:
            title = f"Content edit suggested ({p['field']}) for {p['requirement_id']}"
            chip, actor = {"text": "edit", "tone": "neutral"}, "pipeline.challenge"
        if p["status"] != "open":
            chip = {"text": p["status"], "tone": "up" if p["status"] == "accepted" else "down"}
        items.append({"id": f"prop:{p['id']}", "ts": p["created_at"], "kind": "proposal", "title": title,
                      "detail": p["reason"], "req_id": p["requirement_id"], "target": p["target"],
                      "actor_type": "ai", "actor": actor, "chip": chip})

    prop_req = {str(r[0]): r[1] for r in conn.execute("SELECT id, requirement_id FROM change_proposal")}
    ph = ",".join("?" * len(DECISION_ACTIONS))
    for e in conn.execute(
            f"""SELECT id, ts, actor_type, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, field, old_value, new_value, rationale
                FROM audit_event WHERE actor_type = 'human' AND action IN ({ph}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 300""",
            DECISION_ACTIONS):
        why = e["rationale"] or ""
        if why.startswith(NESTED_PREFIXES):
            continue
        a, eid = e["action"], e["entity_id"]
        rid = prop_req.get(eid) if e["entity_type"] == "change_proposal" else eid.split(":", 1)[0]
        req_title = titles.get(rid, {}).get("title") or rid
        tgt = _target_from_entity(eid) if e["entity_type"] == "requirement_target" else None
        kind = "decision"
        if a == "set_status":
            new = e["new_value"]
            title = f"{L.STATUS_LABELS.get(new, new)}: {req_title}"
            chip = {"text": L.STATUS_LABELS.get(new, new),
                    "tone": {"approved": "up", "rejected": "down", "deferred": "warn"}.get(new, "neutral")}
        elif a == "set_priority":
            title = f"Priority {e['new_value'] or 'cleared'} for {tgt['label'] if tgt else eid}: {req_title}"
            chip = {"text": e["new_value"] or "cleared", "tone": _tone_priority(e["old_value"], e["new_value"])}
        elif a in ("accept_proposal", "reject_proposal"):
            acc = a == "accept_proposal"
            title = f"{'Accepted' if acc else 'Rejected'} AI suggestion #{eid}: {req_title}"
            chip = {"text": "accepted" if acc else "rejected", "tone": "up" if acc else "down"}
        elif a == "override_gate":
            title, chip = f"Brand gate overridden for {tgt['label'] if tgt else eid}: {req_title}", {"text": "override", "tone": "warn"}
        else:   # challenge
            kind, title, chip = "challenge", f"Challenged: {req_title}", {"text": "challenged", "tone": "warn"}
        items.append({"id": f"audit:{e['id']}", "ts": e["ts"], "kind": kind, "title": title, "detail": why or None,
                      "req_id": rid, "target": tgt, "actor_type": "human", "actor": e["actor_id"], "chip": chip})

    for e in conn.execute("""SELECT id, ts, actor_id, entity_id, new_value, rationale FROM audit_event
                             WHERE action = 'challenge_response' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"""):
        verdict = (loads(e["new_value"], {}) or {}).get("verdict")
        items.append({"id": f"audit:{e['id']}", "ts": e["ts"], "kind": "challenge",
                      "title": f"AI answered the challenge on {e['entity_id']}: {titles.get(e['entity_id'], {}).get('title') or ''}".rstrip(": "),
                      "detail": e["rationale"], "req_id": e["entity_id"], "target": None, "actor_type": "ai",
                      "actor": e["actor_id"], "chip": {"text": L.VERDICTS.get(verdict, verdict or "answer"),
                                                       "tone": "warn" if verdict in ("upheld", "partially_upheld") else "neutral"}})

    n_props = dict(conn.execute("SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) FROM change_proposal WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1").fetchall())
    for e in conn.execute("""SELECT id, ts, actor_type, actor_id, entity_id, new_value, rationale FROM audit_event
                             WHERE action = 'start_run' AND entity_type = 'prioritization_run' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"""):
        start = loads(e["new_value"], {}) or {}
        rid_ = int(e["entity_id"]) if str(e["entity_id"]).isdigit() else None
        n = n_props.get(rid_, 0)
        items.append({"id": f"audit:{e['id']}", "ts": e["ts"], "kind": "run",
                      "title": f"Prioritization run {e['entity_id']} ({str(start.get('trigger') or '').replace('_', ' ')}"
                               + (f", wave {start.get('wave')})" if start.get("wave") else ")"),
                      "detail": e["rationale"], "req_id": None, "target": None, "actor_type": e["actor_type"],
                      "actor": e["actor_id"], "chip": {"text": f"{n} priority suggestion{'s' if n != 1 else ''}", "tone": "neutral"}})
    for e in conn.execute("""SELECT id, ts, actor_type, actor_id, entity_id, rationale FROM audit_event
                             WHERE action = 'open_wave' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20"""):
        w = int(e["entity_id"]) if str(e["entity_id"]).isdigit() else None
        items.append({"id": f"audit:{e['id']}", "ts": e["ts"], "kind": "wave",
                      "title": f"Opened {WAVES[w]['label'] if w in WAVES else 'wave ' + str(e['entity_id'])}",
                      "detail": e["rationale"], "req_id": None, "target": None, "actor_type": e["actor_type"],
                      "actor": e["actor_id"], "chip": {"text": "SIMULATION", "tone": "neutral"}})
    items.sort(key=lambda x: (x["ts"] or "", x["id"]), reverse=True)
    return items[:FEED_MAX]


def queue_size(conn, rows: list[dict] | None = None) -> int:
    """Items in the unfiltered decision queue (requirements to review + open proposals not folded into them)."""
    review = {r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT id FROM requirement WHERE status IN ('proposed', 'challenged')")}
    n = len(review)
    for rid, kind in conn.execute("SELECT requirement_id, COALESCE(kind, 'priority') FROM change_proposal WHERE status = 'open'"):
        if kind == "new_requirement" and rid in review:
            continue
        n += 1
    return n


@router.get("/briefing")
def briefing() -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        w = current_wave(conn)
        runs = conn.execute("SELECT id, ts, trigger, initiated_by FROM prioritization_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2").fetchall()
        run = dict(runs[0]) if runs else None
        prev_id = runs[1]["id"] if len(runs) > 1 else None
        rows = target_rows(conn)
        titles = {r["id"]: dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, category, status, created_at, json_extract(derivation_json, '$.wave') wave FROM requirement")}
        movers, mstats = _movers(conn, run["id"] if run else None, prev_id, titles)
        props = proposals(conn)

        # new requirements drafted in the current wave (with their new_requirement proposal, if any)
        new_ids = [rid for rid, t in titles.items() if w and t["wave"] == w]
        summaries = {s["id"]: s for s in requirement_summaries(conn, new_ids)} if new_ids else {}
        nr_prop = {p["requirement_id"]: p for p in props if p["kind"] == "new_requirement"}
        new_list = []
        for rid in sorted(new_ids, key=lambda r: (titles[r]["created_at"] or "", r), reverse=True):
            s = summaries[rid]
            p = nr_prop.get(rid)
            new_list.append({"req_id": rid, "title": s["title"], "category": s["category"], "status": s["status"],
                             "max_score": s["max_score"], "best_target": s["best_target"],
                             "proposal_id": p["id"] if p else None, "proposal_status": p["status"] if p else None,
                             "reason": p["reason"] if p else f"Drafted when {WAVES.get(w, {}).get('label', 'the wave')} opened"})

        base = verbatim_base(conn, w)
        gaps = evidence_gaps(conn, w, base)
        by_t = defaultdict(list)
        for r in rows:
            if r["status"] != "rejected":
                by_t[(r["vehicle_model_id"], r["market_code"])].append(r)
        pulse = []
        for d, m in all_targets():
            ts = by_t.get((d, m), [])
            pc = {"Must": 0, "Should": 0, "Could": 0}
            for r in ts:
                p = effective(r["pm_priority"], r["proposed_priority"])
                if p in pc:
                    pc[p] += 1
            top = best_first(ts)[0] if ts else None
            pulse.append({
                "target": target_obj(d, m), "n": len(ts), "must": pc["Must"], "should": pc["Should"], "could": pc["Could"],
                "approved": sum(r["status"] == "approved" for r in ts), "pm_confirmed": sum(r["pm_priority"] is not None for r in ts),
                "voice_base": base.get((d, m), {}).get("in_scope", 0), "gaps": gaps.get((d, m), []),
                "top": {"req_id": top["requirement_id"], "title": titles[top["requirement_id"]]["title"],
                        "score": None if top["score"] is None else round(top["score"], 1),
                        "priority": effective(top["pm_priority"], top["proposed_priority"]),
                        "ai_only": top["pm_priority"] is None} if top else None,
            })
        feed = _feed(conn, props, titles)
        waiting = queue_size(conn)
        merges_open = sum(p["kind"] == "extend" and p["status"] == "open" for p in props)
        n_conf = len(conflict_info(rows))
    wave = WAVES.get(w)
    return {
        "wave": {"n": w, "label": wave["label"] if wave else None, "simulated_date": wave["simulated_date"] if wave else None},
        "run": run, "previous_run_id": prev_id,
        "headline": {"new_requirements": len(new_ids), "priority_changes": mstats["priority_changes"],
                     "risers": mstats["risers"], "fallers": mstats["fallers"], "merges_open": merges_open,
                     "conflicts": n_conf},
        "movers": movers, "new_requirements": new_list[:6], "feed": feed, "pulse": pulse,
        "decisions_waiting": waiting,
    }

            p = nr_prop.get(rid)
            new_list.append({"req_id": rid, "title": s["title"], "category": s["category"], "status": s["status"],
                             "max_score": s["max_score"], "best_target": s["best_target"],
                             "proposal_id": p["id"] if p else None, "proposal_status": p["status"] if p else None,
                             "reason": p["reason"] if p else f"Drafted when {WAVES.get(w, {}).get('label', 'the wave')} opened"})

        base = verbatim_base(conn, w)
        gaps = evidence_gaps(conn, w, base)
        by_t = defaultdict(list)
        for r in rows:
            if r["status"] != "rejected":
                by_t[(r["vehicle_model_id"], r["market_code"])].append(r)
        pulse = []
        for d, m in all_targets():
            ts = by_t.get((d, m), [])
            pc = {"Must": 0, "Should": 0, "Could": 0}
            for r in ts:
                p = effective(r["pm_priority"], r["proposed_priority"])
                if p in pc:
                    pc[p] += 1
            top = best_first(ts)[0] if ts else None
            pulse.append({
                "target": target_obj(d, m), "n": len(ts), "must": pc["Must"], "should": pc["Should"], "could": pc["Could"],
                "approved": sum(r["status"] == "approved" for r in ts), "pm_confirmed": sum(r["pm_priority"] is not None for r in ts),
                "voice_base": base.get((d, m), {}).get("in_scope", 0), "gaps": gaps.get((d, m), []),
                "top": {"req_id": top["requirement_id"], "title": titles[top["requirement_id"]]["title"],

                        "priority": effective(top["pm_priority"], top["proposed_priority"]),
                        "ai_only": top["pm_priority"] is None} if top else None,
            })
        feed = _feed(conn, props, titles)
        waiting = queue_size(conn)
        merges_open = sum(p["kind"] == "extend" and p["status"] == "open" for p in props)
        n_conf = len(conflict_info(rows))
    wave = WAVES.get(w)
    return {
        "wave": {"n": w, "label": wave["label"] if wave else None, "simulated_date": wave["simulated_date"] if wave else None},
        "run": run, "previous_run_id": prev_id,
        "headline": {"new_requirements": len(new_ids), "priority_changes": mstats["priority_changes"],
                     "risers": mstats["risers"], "fallers": mstats["fallers"], "merges_open": merges_open,
                     "conflicts": n_conf},
        "movers": movers, "new_requirements": new_list[:6], "feed": feed, "pulse": pulse,
        "decisions_waiting": waiting,
    }

"""Requirements: list, detail (with the review context), history, evidence chain, audit, step-by-step trace, and every
PM write (status, gate override, priorities, content edit, evidence links, challenge) plus access logging.

Writes go through `bmw_req.service` only (append-only audit inside). The API adds the validation the service leaves
to the UI: enums, existence of requirement / target / finding, no partial priority writes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from api import jobs, labels as L
from api.deps import action_errors, conflict, db, get_actor, need_rationale, not_found
from api.queries import (current_wave, enrich_breakdown, latest_extractor, loads, metrics_wave, parse_key, proposals,
                         require_requirement, requirement_summaries, requirement_summary, run_waves, split_bullets,
                         spend_by_prefix, target_obj, tkey, voice_of)
from bmw_req import service
from bmw_req.car_zones import requirement_zone
from bmw_req.pipeline.scoring import CONFIDENCE, EFFORT_MOD, MARKET_FIT_MOD, PRIORITY_BANDS

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["requirements"])

DERIVATION_KEYS = ("product_decision", "evidence_summary", "horizon_reason", "effort_reason")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ reads
@router.get("/requirements")
def list_requirements(status: str | None = Query(None, description="comma-separated statuses"),
                      vehicle: str | None = None, market: str | None = None, category: str | None = None,
                      q: str | None = None, include_rejected: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
    with db() as conn:
        items = requirement_summaries(conn)
        texts = {r[0]: f"{r[0]} {r[1] or ''} {r[2] or ''}".lower() for r in
                 conn.execute("SELECT id, title, description FROM requirement")}
    statuses = {s.strip() for s in status.split(",") if s.strip()} if status else None
    out = []
    for s in items:
        if statuses is not None:
            if s["status"] not in statuses:
                continue
        elif not include_rejected and s["status"] == "rejected":
            continue
        if category and s["category"] != category:
            continue
        if vehicle or market:
            if not any((not vehicle or t["target"]["vehicle"] == vehicle) and (not market or t["target"]["market"] == market)
                       for t in s["targets"]):
                continue
        if q and q.lower() not in texts.get(s["id"], ""):
            continue
        out.append(s)
    return out


def _quotes(conn, rid: str, wave: int) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT s.external_id, s.market_code AS market, s.country, fs.quote, f.id AS finding_id
           FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id AND f.source_kind = 'verbatim'
           JOIN finding_source fs ON fs.finding_id = f.id JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id
           WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports' AND fs.quote IS NOT NULL AND s.wave <= ?
           ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_source x WHERE x.finding_id = f.id) DESC, s.id LIMIT 8""",
        (rid, wave or 99))]


def _linked(conn, rid: str, kind: str, wave: int, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT f.id, f.title, f.type, f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code, f.metrics_json FROM requirement_finding rf
           JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports'
           AND f.source_kind = ? AND COALESCE(f.first_wave, 1) <= ? ORDER BY f.id LIMIT ?""",
        (rid, kind, wave or 99, limit))]


def latest_fit(conn, rid: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        """SELECT f.* FROM fit_check f WHERE f.requirement_id = ? AND f.id = (
             SELECT MAX(g.id) FROM fit_check g WHERE g.requirement_id = f.requirement_id
             AND COALESCE(g.vehicle_model_id,'') = COALESCE(f.vehicle_model_id,'')
             AND COALESCE(g.market_code,'') = COALESCE(f.market_code,'') AND g.check_type = f.check_type)
           ORDER BY f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code, f.check_type""", (rid,)).fetchall()
    return [{"target": target_obj(r["vehicle_model_id"], r["market_code"]), "check_type": r["check_type"],
             "result": r["result"], "rationale": r["rationale"], "checked_by": r["checked_by"],
             "checked_at": r["checked_at"]} for r in rows]


def challenges(conn, rid: str) -> list[dict]:
    """PM challenges paired with the AI answers by following event id order: each `challenge` opens an entry, the
    next `challenge_response` before the following `challenge` answers it (an orphan answer gets its own entry)."""
    out: list[dict] = []
    for e in conn.execute("""SELECT id, ts, actor_id, action, new_value, rationale, model FROM audit_event
                             WHERE entity_type = 'requirement' AND entity_id = ?
                             AND action IN ('challenge', 'challenge_response') ORDER BY id""", (rid,)):
        if e["action"] == "challenge":
            out.append({"asked_at": e["ts"], "actor": e["actor_id"], "question": e["rationale"],
                        "answered_at": None, "model": None, "answer": None})
        else:
            ans = loads(e["new_value"], {}) or {}
            answer = {k: ans.get(k) for k in ("verdict", "answer", "evidence_for", "evidence_against",
                                               "proposed_edits", "link_finding_ids")}
            if out and out[-1]["answer"] is None:
                out[-1].update(answered_at=e["ts"], model=e["model"], answer=answer)
            else:
                out.append({"asked_at": None, "actor": None, "question": None, "answered_at": e["ts"],
                            "model": e["model"], "answer": answer})
    return out


@router.get("/requirements/{rid}")
def requirement_detail(rid: str) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        req = require_requirement(conn, rid)
        w = current_wave(conn)
        s = requirement_summary(conn, rid)
        bmap = {(r[0], r[1]): loads(r[2]) for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, score_breakdown_json FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?",
            (rid,))}
        quotes = _quotes(conn, rid, w)
        study = _linked(conn, rid, "study", w, 6)
        web = _linked(conn, rid, "web", w, 6)
        contra = [{"finding_id": r[0], "title": r[1], "source_kind": r[2]} for r in conn.execute(
            """SELECT f.id, f.title, f.source_kind FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id
               WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'contradicts' ORDER BY f.id""", (rid,))]
        fit = latest_fit(conn, rid)
        open_props = proposals(conn, "p.requirement_id = ? AND p.status = 'open'", (rid,))
        chal = challenges(conn, rid)
    deriv = loads(req.pop("derivation_json", None))
    derivation = None
    if isinstance(deriv, dict):
        derivation = {k: deriv[k] for k in DERIVATION_KEYS if deriv.get(k)}
        derivation.update(supporting_finding_ids=deriv.get("supporting_finding_ids") or [],
                          conflicting_finding_ids=deriv.get("conflicting_finding_ids") or [],
                          wave=deriv.get("wave"), prompt=deriv.get("prompt"))
    targets = []
    for t in s["targets"]:
        b = bmap.get((t["target"]["vehicle"], t["target"]["market"]))
        targets.append({**t, "breakdown": enrich_breakdown(b), "voice": voice_of(b)})
    study_out = []
    for f in study:
        m = loads(f["metrics_json"], {}) or {}
        study_out.append({"finding_id": f["id"], "title": f["title"], "type": f["type"], "market": f["market_code"],
                          "vehicle": f["vehicle_model_id"], "mean": m.get("mean"), "z": m.get("z"), "scale": m.get("scale")})
    web_out = []
    for f in web:
        m = loads(f["metrics_json"], {}) or {}
        tiers = sorted((m.get("tiers") or {}).keys())
        web_out.append({"finding_id": f["id"], "title": f["title"], "type": f["type"], "market": f["market_code"],
                        "vehicle": f["vehicle_model_id"], "best_tier": tiers[0] if tiers else None,
                        "publishers": m.get("publishers") or [], "newest_date": m.get("newest_date")})
    return {
        **req, "must_not_lose": bool(req.get("must_not_lose")),
        "zone": requirement_zone(req["title"], req["category"], req.get("description")),
        "max_score": s["max_score"], "best_target": s["best_target"],
        "derivation": derivation,
        "assumptions_list": split_bullets(req.get("assumptions")),
        "uncertainties_list": split_bullets(req.get("uncertainties")),
        "targets": targets, "brand_blocked": s["brand_blocked"],
        "overridden": [t["target"]["key"] for t in s["targets"] if t["brand_gate"] == "overridden"],
        "quotes": quotes, "study": study_out, "web": web_out, "contradicting": contra,
        "fit": fit, "open_proposals": open_props, "challenges": chal,
    }


@router.get("/requirements/{rid}/history")
def history(rid: str) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        rw = run_waves(conn)
        series = defaultdict(list)
        for r in conn.execute(
                """SELECT s.run_id, s.vehicle_model_id v, s.market_code m, s.score, s.rank, s.priority, r.ts, r.trigger
                   FROM score_snapshot s JOIN prioritization_run r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE s.requirement_id = ?
                   ORDER BY s.vehicle_model_id, s.market_code, s.run_id""", (rid,)):
            series[(r["v"], r["m"])].append({"run_id": r["run_id"], "ts": r["ts"], "trigger": r["trigger"],
                                             "wave": rw.get(r["run_id"]),
                                             "score": None if r["score"] is None else round(r["score"], 1),
                                             "rank": r["rank"], "priority": r["priority"]})
        causes = [{"run_id": r["run_id"], "target_key": r["entity_id"].split(":", 1)[1], "rationale": r["rationale"]}
                  for r in conn.execute("""SELECT run_id, entity_id, rationale FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'rescore'
                                           AND entity_id LIKE ? ORDER BY id""", (f"{rid}:%",))]
    return {"series": [{"target": target_obj(v, m), "points": pts} for (v, m), pts in series.items()], "causes": causes}


def finding_cards(conn, rows: list[dict], wave: int) -> list[dict]:
    """Linked findings with source counts, signal counts and per-market metrics (verbatim) or flat metrics."""
    if not rows:
        return []
    ids = tuple(r["id"] for r in rows)
    ph = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
    counts = defaultdict(list)
    n_src = defaultdict(int)
    for r in conn.execute(
            f"""SELECT fs.finding_id, s.kind, COALESCE(s.market_code, '–') market, COUNT(*) n, MIN(s.trust_tier) tier
                FROM finding_source fs JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id WHERE fs.finding_id IN ({ph})
                GROUP BY 1, 2, 3""", ids):
        counts[r[0]].append({"kind": r[1], "market": r[2], "n": r[3], "tier": r[4]})
        n_src[r[0]] += r[3]
    n_sig = dict(conn.execute(f"SELECT finding_id, COUNT(*) FROM finding_signal WHERE finding_id IN ({ph}) GROUP BY 1",
                              ids).fetchall())
    mw = metrics_wave(wave)
    out = []
    for f in rows:
        m = loads(f.get("metrics_json"), {}) or {}
        card = {"id": f["id"], "source_kind": f["source_kind"], "type": f["type"], "title": f["title"],
                "summary": f["summary"], "category": f["category"], "vehicle": f["vehicle_model_id"],
                "market": f["market_code"], "polarity": f.get("polarity"), "first_wave": f["first_wave"],
                "relation": f.get("relation"), "n_sources": n_src.get(f["id"], 0), "n_signals": n_sig.get(f["id"], 0),
                "source_counts": counts.get(f["id"], [])}
        if f["source_kind"] == "verbatim":
            bw = (m.get("by_wave") or {}).get(mw) or {}
            card["verbatims"] = bw.get("verbatims")
            card["markets"] = bw.get("markets") or {}
            card["metrics_wave"] = mw
        else:
            card["metrics"] = m
        out.append(card)
    return out


@router.get("/requirements/{rid}/evidence")
def evidence(rid: str) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        rows = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
            """SELECT f.id, f.source_kind, f.type, f.title, f.summary, f.category, f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code,
                      f.metrics_json, f.first_wave, f.polarity, rf.relation
               FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id WHERE rf.requirement_id = ?
               ORDER BY rf.relation DESC, f.id""", (rid,))]
        return {"findings": finding_cards(conn, rows, current_wave(conn))}


@router.get("/requirements/{rid}/audit")
def requirement_audit(rid: str, human_only: bool = False, order: Literal["asc", "desc"] = "asc") -> list[dict]:
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        ev = service.requirement_trail(conn, rid)
    if human_only:
        ev = [e for e in ev if e["actor_type"] == "human"]
    return ev[::-1] if order == "desc" else ev


@router.get("/requirements/{rid}/trace")
def trace(rid: str, target: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """'How it works' for one requirement × target: per step the global rule/stats and what happened here."""
    with db() as conn:
        req = require_requirement(conn, rid)
        deriv = loads(req.get("derivation_json"), {}) or {}
        s = requirement_summary(conn, rid)
        if not s["targets"]:
            raise conflict(f"{rid} has no car · market targets yet")
        if target:
            v, m = parse_key(target)
        else:
            keys = [(t["target"]["vehicle"], t["target"]["market"]) for t in s["targets"]]
            v, m = ("G60", "US") if ("G60", "US") in keys else keys[0]
        trow = next((t for t in s["targets"] if (t["target"]["vehicle"], t["target"]["market"]) == (v, m)), None)
        if trow is None:
            raise not_found(f"{rid} has no target {tkey(v, m)}")
        b = loads(conn.execute("""SELECT score_breakdown_json FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?
                                  AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?""", (rid, v, m)).fetchone()[0], {}) or {}
        spend = spend_by_prefix(conn)

        def sp(*prefixes):
            return {"calls": sum(spend.get(p, {}).get("calls", 0) for p in prefixes),
                    "usd": round(sum(spend.get(p, {}).get("usd", 0) for p in prefixes), 4)}

        # 1 collect
        src = dict(conn.execute("SELECT kind, COUNT(*) FROM source_item GROUP BY kind").fetchall())
        ex_sql = """SELECT s.id sid, s.external_id, s.ref, s.text, s.country, s.market_code, s.meta_json, s.wave,
                           f.id fid, f.title ftitle FROM requirement_finding rf
                    JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id AND f.source_kind = 'verbatim'
                    JOIN finding_signal fs ON fs.finding_id = f.id JOIN signal g ON g.id = fs.signal_id
                    JOIN source_item s ON s.id = g.source_item_id
                    WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports' {extra}
                    ORDER BY CASE g.severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, g.quote_verified DESC,
                             g.support_question, length(s.text) BETWEEN 60 AND 400 DESC, s.id LIMIT 1"""
        ex = conn.execute(ex_sql.format(extra="AND s.vehicle_model_id = ? AND s.market_code = ?"), (rid, v, m)).fetchone()
        other_market = False
        if ex is None:
            ex = conn.execute(ex_sql.format(extra=""), (rid,)).fetchone()
            other_market = ex is not None
        example = None
        if ex is not None:
            meta = loads(ex["meta_json"], {}) or {}
            text = ex["text"] or ""
            example = {"source_id": ex["sid"], "external_id": ex["external_id"], "ref": ex["ref"],
                       "text": text if len(text) <= 600 else text[:599] + "…", "country": ex["country"],
                       "market": ex["market_code"], "channel": meta.get("channel"), "wave": ex["wave"]}
        # 2 read
        ver = latest_extractor(conn)
        n_ext = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verbatim_extraction WHERE extractor_version = ?", (ver,)).fetchone()[0]
        n_in = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(in_scope), 0) FROM verbatim_extraction WHERE extractor_version = ?",
                            (ver,)).fetchone()[0]
        n_sig, n_unver = conn.execute("""SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(quote_verified = 0), 0) FROM signal
                                         WHERE extractor_version = ?""", (ver,)).fetchone()
        sigs = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
            """SELECT id AS signal_id, category, topic, feedback_type, severity, need_statement, quote, quote_verified,
                      support_question FROM signal WHERE source_item_id = ? AND extractor_version = ?""",
            (ex["sid"], ver))] if ex is not None else []
        # 3 group
        fk = dict(conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(source_kind, 'other'), COUNT(*) FROM finding GROUP BY 1").fetchall())
        links = [{"kind": r[0], "relation": r[1], "n": r[2]} for r in conn.execute(
            """SELECT f.source_kind, rf.relation, COUNT(*) FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id
               WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? GROUP BY 1, 2""", (rid,))]
        finding = None
        if ex is not None:
            f = conn.execute("SELECT id, title, summary, metrics_json FROM finding WHERE id = ?", (ex["fid"],)).fetchone()
            mk = ((((loads(f["metrics_json"], {}) or {}).get("by_wave") or {}).get("2") or {}).get("markets") or {})
            finding = {"id": f["id"], "title": f["title"], "summary": f["summary"],
                       "n_signals": conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_signal WHERE finding_id = ?", (f["id"],)).fetchone()[0],
                       "markets": [{"market": k, "verbatims": x.get("verbatims"), "share": x.get("share")} for k, x in mk.items()]}
        # 4 draft
        n_req = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirement").fetchone()[0]
        merges = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'match_existing'").fetchone()[0]
        # 5 fit
        fit_matrix = [{"check_type": r[0], "result": r[1], "n": r[2]} for r in
                      conn.execute("SELECT check_type, result, COUNT(*) FROM fit_check GROUP BY 1, 2")]
        fit_here = [f for f in latest_fit(conn, rid) if f["target"] and (f["target"]["vehicle"], f["target"]["market"]) == (v, m)]
        # 7 decide

def waterfall(b: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Score arithmetic as steps: factor points (without confidence), the confidence cut, modifiers, total."""
    facs = (b or {}).get("factors") or {}
    if not facs:
        return []
    conf = float(b.get("confidence") or 1.0)
    wsum = sum(f["weight"] for f in facs.values() if f.get("available")) or 1
    rows, run = [], 0.0
    for key, f in facs.items():
        if not f.get("available"):
            continue
        pts = 100 * f["weight"] * (f["value"] or 0) / wsum
        rows.append({"step": f["label"], "factor": key, "kind": "factor", "start": round(run, 2),
                     "end": round(run + pts, 2), "delta": round(pts, 2)})
        run += pts
    cut = run * (1 - conf)
    if cut >= 0.05:
        rows.append({"step": f"Evidence confidence ×{conf}", "factor": None, "kind": "minus", "start": round(run - cut, 2),
                     "end": round(run, 2), "delta": round(-cut, 2)})
        run -= cut
    for k, val in (b.get("modifiers") or {}).items():
        if val:
            rows.append({"step": k.replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "factor": None, "kind": "plus" if val > 0 else "minus",
                         "start": round(min(run, run + val), 2), "end": round(max(run, run + val), 2),
                         "delta": round(val, 2)})
            run += val
    rows.append({"step": "Score", "factor": None, "kind": "total", "start": 0, "end": float(b.get("score", run)),
                 "delta": float(b.get("score", run))})
    return rows


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ writes
class StatusBody(BaseModel):
    status: Literal["approved", "rejected", "deferred", "challenged", "proposed"]
    rationale: str
    accept_ai_priorities: bool = False


class OverrideBody(BaseModel):
    target: str
    rationale: str


class PrioritiesBody(BaseModel):
    priorities: dict[str, Literal["Must", "Should", "Could"] | None] = Field(min_length=1)
    rationale: str


class EditBody(BaseModel):
    changes: dict[str, Any] = Field(min_length=1)
    rationale: str


class LinkBody(BaseModel):
    relation: Literal["supports", "contradicts"] | None
    rationale: str


class ChallengeBody(BaseModel):
    question: str


class AccessBody(BaseModel):
    action: Literal["view", "export"]
    entity_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    entity_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    detail: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


@router.post("/requirements/{rid}/status")
def set_status(rid: str, body: StatusBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    done: list[str] = []
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        with action_errors():
            service.set_status(conn, rid, body.status, actor, why)
        if body.accept_ai_priorities and body.status != "rejected":
            for t in conn.execute("""SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, proposed_priority FROM requirement_target
                                     WHERE requirement_id = ? AND priority IS NULL AND proposed_priority IS NOT NULL
                                     ORDER BY vehicle_model_id, market_code""", (rid,)).fetchall():
                try:
                    service.set_priority(conn, rid, t[0], t[1], t[2], actor,
                                         f"Accepted the AI suggestion with the decision: {why}")
                except service.ActionError:
                    break
                done.append(tkey(t[0], t[1]))
        return {"requirement": requirement_summary(conn, rid), "priorities_set": done}


@router.post("/requirements/{rid}/override")
def override(rid: str, body: OverrideBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    v, m = parse_key(body.target)
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?",
                        (rid, v, m)).fetchone() is None:
            raise not_found(f"{rid} has no target {tkey(v, m)}")
        with action_errors():
            service.override_gate(conn, rid, tkey(v, m), actor, why)
        return {"overridden": tkey(v, m), "brand_blocked": service.brand_blocked(conn, rid)}


@router.put("/requirements/{rid}/priorities")
def set_priorities(rid: str, body: PrioritiesBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    wanted = {parse_key(k): p for k, p in body.priorities.items()}
    changed: list[str] = []
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        cur = {(r[0], r[1]): r[2] for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, priority FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?", (rid,))}
        missing = [tkey(*k) for k in wanted if k not in cur]
        if missing:   # validate everything before writing anything
            raise conflict(f"{rid} has no target {', '.join(missing)}")
        with action_errors():
            for (v, m), p in wanted.items():
                if cur[(v, m)] != p:
                    service.set_priority(conn, rid, v, m, p, actor, why)
                    changed.append(tkey(v, m))
    return {"changed": changed}


@router.patch("/requirements/{rid}")
def edit(rid: str, body: EditBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    unknown = sorted(set(body.changes) - set(service.EDITABLE))
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(422, f"Not editable: {', '.join(unknown)} (editable: {', '.join(service.EDITABLE)})")
    for k, v in body.changes.items():
        if v is not None and not isinstance(v, str):
            raise HTTPException(422, f"{k} must be a string or null")
        if k in L.ENUMS and v not in L.ENUMS[k]:
            raise HTTPException(422, f"{k} must be one of {L.ENUMS[k]}")
        if k == "title" and not (v or "").strip():
            raise HTTPException(422, "title must not be empty")
    with db() as conn:
        cur = require_requirement(conn, rid)
        changed = [k for k, v in body.changes.items() if v != cur.get(k)]
        with action_errors():
            version = service.edit_requirement(conn, rid, body.changes, actor, why)
    return {"version": version, "changed": changed}


@router.put("/requirements/{rid}/findings/{fid}")
def set_link(rid: str, fid: int, body: LinkBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM finding WHERE id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone() is None:
            raise not_found(f"No finding F{fid}")
        old = conn.execute("SELECT relation FROM requirement_finding WHERE requirement_id = ? AND finding_id = ?",
                           (rid, fid)).fetchone()
        old_rel = old[0] if old else None
        if old_rel == body.relation:
            if old_rel is None:
                raise conflict(f"F{fid} is not linked to {rid}")
            return {"relation": old_rel, "changed": False}
        with action_errors():
            service.set_finding_link(conn, rid, fid, body.relation, actor, why)
    return {"relation": body.relation, "changed": True}


@router.post("/requirements/{rid}/challenge", status_code=202)
def challenge(rid: str, body: ChallengeBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> JSONResponse:
    question = need_rationale(body.question, "A question")
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
    jid = jobs.start("challenge", jobs.run_challenge(rid, question, actor), {"requirement_id": rid})
    if jid is None:
        raise conflict(f"Another job is running ({(jobs.running() or {}).get('id')}); try again when it has finished.")
    return JSONResponse({"job_id": jid}, status_code=202)


@router.post("/access")
def access(body: AccessBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        service.log_access(conn, actor, body.action, body.entity_type, body.entity_id, body.detail)
    return {"ok": True}


__all__ = ["router", "finding_cards", "latest_fit"]

@router.get("/requirements")

                      vehicle: str | None = None, market: str | None = None, category: str | None = None,
                      q: str | None = None, include_rejected: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
    with db() as conn:
        items = requirement_summaries(conn)

                 conn.execute("SELECT id, title, description FROM requirement")}
    statuses = {s.strip() for s in status.split(",") if s.strip()} if status else None

    for s in items:
        if statuses is not None:

        elif not include_rejected and s["status"] == "rejected":
            continue

        if vehicle or market:

                       for t in s["targets"]):

def challenges(conn, rid: str) -> list[dict]:
    """PM challenges paired with the AI answers by following event id order: each `challenge` opens an entry, the
    next `challenge_response` before the following `challenge` answers it (an orphan answer gets its own entry)."""
    out: list[dict] = []
    for e in conn.execute("""SELECT id, ts, actor_id, action, new_value, rationale, model FROM audit_event
                             WHERE entity_type = 'requirement' AND entity_id = ?
                             AND action IN ('challenge', 'challenge_response') ORDER BY id""", (rid,)):
        if e["action"] == "challenge":
            out.append({"asked_at": e["ts"], "actor": e["actor_id"], "question": e["rationale"],
                        "answered_at": None, "model": None, "answer": None})
        else:
            ans = loads(e["new_value"], {}) or {}
            answer = {k: ans.get(k) for k in ("verdict", "answer", "evidence_for", "evidence_against",
                                               "proposed_edits", "link_finding_ids")}
            if out and out[-1]["answer"] is None:
                out[-1].update(answered_at=e["ts"], model=e["model"], answer=answer)
            else:
                out.append({"asked_at": None, "actor": None, "question": None, "answered_at": e["ts"],

               ORDER BY rf.relation DESC, f.id""", (rid,))]

                                  AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?""", (rid, v, m)).fetchone()[0], {}) or {}
        spend = spend_by_prefix(conn)

        def sp(*prefixes):

                    JOIN source_item s ON s.id = g.source_item_id
                    WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports' {extra}
                    ORDER BY CASE g.severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, g.quote_verified DESC,
                             g.support_question, length(s.text) BETWEEN 60 AND 400 DESC, s.id LIMIT 1"""
        ex = conn.execute(ex_sql.format(extra="AND s.vehicle_model_id = ? AND s.market_code = ?"), (rid, v, m)).fetchone()
        other_market = False

        # 2 read

                      "title": req["title"], "description": req["description"], "horizon": req["horizon"],

                      "n_supporting": len(deriv.get("supporting_finding_ids") or []),
                      "product_decision": deriv.get("product_decision"), "evidence_summary": deriv.get("evidence_summary"),
                      "assumptions": split_bullets(asm) if isinstance(asm, str) else (asm or []),
                      "horizon_reason": deriv.get("horizon_reason")},
            "fit": {"global": {"matrix": fit_matrix, "spend": sp("fit")}, "checks": fit_here},
            "score": {"global": {"confidence": CONFIDENCE, "effort_mod": EFFORT_MOD, "market_fit_mod": MARKET_FIT_MOD,

                      "breakdown": enrich_breakdown(b) if b else None, "waterfall": waterfall(b),
                      "score": trow["score"], "ai_priority": trow["ai_priority"],
                      "cap_note": b.get("cap_note"), "priority_note": b.get("priority_note"),

            "decide": {"global": {"by_actor_type": dict(by_actor)}, "status": req["status"],
                       "pm_priority": trow["pm_priority"], "ai_priority": trow["ai_priority"],
                       "human_events": [e for e in ev if e["actor_type"] == "human"][-8:]},
            "repeat": {"global": {"proposal_status_counts": dict(status_counts)},

                                      "cause": causes.get(h["run_id"])} for h in hist],
                       "proposals": props[-3:]},
        },
    }


def waterfall(b: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Score arithmetic as steps: factor points (without confidence), the confidence cut, modifiers, total."""
    facs = (b or {}).get("factors") or {}
    if not facs:
        return []
    conf = float(b.get("confidence") or 1.0)
    wsum = sum(f["weight"] for f in facs.values() if f.get("available")) or 1
    rows, run = [], 0.0
    for key, f in facs.items():
        if not f.get("available"):
            continue
        pts = 100 * f["weight"] * (f["value"] or 0) / wsum
        rows.append({"step": f["label"], "factor": key, "kind": "factor", "start": round(run, 2),
                     "end": round(run + pts, 2), "delta": round(pts, 2)})
        run += pts
    cut = run * (1 - conf)
    if cut >= 0.05:
        rows.append({"step": f"Evidence confidence ×{conf}", "factor": None, "kind": "minus", "start": round(run - cut, 2),
                     "end": round(run, 2), "delta": round(-cut, 2)})
        run -= cut
    for k, val in (b.get("modifiers") or {}).items():
        if val:
            rows.append({"step": k.replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "factor": None, "kind": "plus" if val > 0 else "minus",
                         "start": round(min(run, run + val), 2), "end": round(max(run, run + val), 2),
                         "delta": round(val, 2)})
            run += val
    rows.append({"step": "Score", "factor": None, "kind": "total", "start": 0, "end": float(b.get("score", run)),
                 "delta": float(b.get("score", run))})
    return rows

@router.post("/requirements/{rid}/status")

    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        with action_errors():
            service.set_status(conn, rid, body.status, actor, why)
        if body.accept_ai_priorities and body.status != "rejected":
            for t in conn.execute("""SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, proposed_priority FROM requirement_target
                                     WHERE requirement_id = ? AND priority IS NULL AND proposed_priority IS NOT NULL
                                     ORDER BY vehicle_model_id, market_code""", (rid,)).fetchall():
                try:
                    service.set_priority(conn, rid, t[0], t[1], t[2], actor,
                                         f"Accepted the AI suggestion with the decision: {why}")

@router.post("/requirements/{rid}/override")
def override(rid: str, body: OverrideBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    v, m = parse_key(body.target)
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?",
                        (rid, v, m)).fetchone() is None:
            raise not_found(f"{rid} has no target {tkey(v, m)}")

@router.put("/requirements/{rid}/priorities")
def set_priorities(rid: str, body: PrioritiesBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    wanted = {parse_key(k): p for k, p in body.priorities.items()}
    changed: list[str] = []
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        cur = {(r[0], r[1]): r[2] for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, priority FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?", (rid,))}
        missing = [tkey(*k) for k in wanted if k not in cur]
        if missing:   # validate everything before writing anything
            raise conflict(f"{rid} has no target {', '.join(missing)}")
        with action_errors():
            for (v, m), p in wanted.items():
                if cur[(v, m)] != p:
                    service.set_priority(conn, rid, v, m, p, actor, why)
                    changed.append(tkey(v, m))
    return {"changed": changed}


@router.patch("/requirements/{rid}")
def edit(rid: str, body: EditBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    unknown = sorted(set(body.changes) - set(service.EDITABLE))
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(422, f"Not editable: {', '.join(unknown)} (editable: {', '.join(service.EDITABLE)})")
    for k, v in body.changes.items():
        if v is not None and not isinstance(v, str):
            raise HTTPException(422, f"{k} must be a string or null")
        if k in L.ENUMS and v not in L.ENUMS[k]:
            raise HTTPException(422, f"{k} must be one of {L.ENUMS[k]}")
        if k == "title" and not (v or "").strip():
            raise HTTPException(422, "title must not be empty")
    with db() as conn:
        cur = require_requirement(conn, rid)
        changed = [k for k, v in body.changes.items() if v != cur.get(k)]
        with action_errors():
            version = service.edit_requirement(conn, rid, body.changes, actor, why)
    return {"version": version, "changed": changed}


@router.put("/requirements/{rid}/findings/{fid}")
def set_link(rid: str, fid: int, body: LinkBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
        if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM finding WHERE id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone() is None:
            raise not_found(f"No finding F{fid}")
        old = conn.execute("SELECT relation FROM requirement_finding WHERE requirement_id = ? AND finding_id = ?",
                           (rid, fid)).fetchone()
        old_rel = old[0] if old else None
        if old_rel == body.relation:
            if old_rel is None:
                raise conflict(f"F{fid} is not linked to {rid}")
            return {"relation": old_rel, "changed": False}
        with action_errors():
            service.set_finding_link(conn, rid, fid, body.relation, actor, why)
    return {"relation": body.relation, "changed": True}


@router.post("/requirements/{rid}/challenge", status_code=202)
def challenge(rid: str, body: ChallengeBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> JSONResponse:
    question = need_rationale(body.question, "A question")
    with db() as conn:
        require_requirement(conn, rid)
    jid = jobs.start("challenge", jobs.run_challenge(rid, question, actor), {"requirement_id": rid})
    if jid is None:
        raise conflict(f"Another job is running ({(jobs.running() or {}).get('id')}); try again when it has finished.")
    return JSONResponse({"job_id": jid}, status_code=202)


@router.post("/access")
def access(body: AccessBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        service.log_access(conn, actor, body.action, body.entity_type, body.entity_id, body.detail)
    return {"ok": True}

"""Requirements: list, detail (with the review context), history, evidence chain, audit, step-by-step trace, and every
PM write (status, gate override, priorities, content edit, evidence links, challenge) plus access logging.

Writes go through `bmw_req.service` only (append-only audit inside). The API adds the validation the service leaves
to the UI: enums, existence of requirement / target / finding, no partial priority writes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from api import jobs, labels as L
from api.deps import action_errors, conflict, db, get_actor, need_rationale, not_found
from api.queries import (current_wave, enrich_breakdown, latest_extractor, loads, metrics_wave, parse_key, proposals,
                         require_requirement, requirement_summaries, requirement_summary, run_waves, split_bullets,
                         spend_by_prefix, target_obj, tkey, voice_of)
from bmw_req import service
from bmw_req.car_zones import requirement_zone
from bmw_req.pipeline.scoring import CONFIDENCE, EFFORT_MOD, MARKET_FIT_MOD, PRIORITY_BANDS

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["requirements"])

DERIVATION_KEYS = ("product_decision", "evidence_summary", "horizon_reason", "effort_reason")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ reads
@router.get("/requirements")
def list_requirements(status: str | None = Query(None, description="comma-separated statuses"),
                      vehicle: str | None = None, market: str | None = None, category: str | None = None,
                      q: str | None = None, include_rejected: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
    with db() as conn:
        items = requirement_summaries(conn)
        texts = {r[0]: f"{r[0]} {r[1] or ''} {r[2] or ''}".lower() for r in
                 conn.execute("SELECT id, title, description FROM requirement")}
    statuses = {s.strip() for s in status.split(",") if s.strip()} if status else None
    out = []
    for s in items:
        if statuses is not None:
            if s["status"] not in statuses:
                continue
        elif not include_rejected and s["status"] == "rejected":
            continue
        if category and s["category"] != category:
            continue
        if vehicle or market:
            if not any((not vehicle or t["target"]["vehicle"] == vehicle) and (not market or t["target"]["market"] == market)
                       for t in s["targets"]):
                continue
        if q and q.lower() not in texts.get(s["id"], ""):
            continue
        out.append(s)
    return out


def _quotes(conn, rid: str, wave: int) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT s.external_id, s.market_code AS market, s.country, fs.quote, f.id AS finding_id
           FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id AND f.source_kind = 'verbatim'
           JOIN finding_source fs ON fs.finding_id = f.id JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id
           WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports' AND fs.quote IS NOT NULL AND s.wave <= ?
           ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_source x WHERE x.finding_id = f.id) DESC, s.id LIMIT 8""",
        (rid, wave or 99))]


def _linked(conn, rid: str, kind: str, wave: int, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT f.id, f.title, f.type, f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code, f.metrics_json FROM requirement_finding rf
           JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports'
           AND f.source_kind = ? AND COALESCE(f.first_wave, 1) <= ? ORDER BY f.id LIMIT ?""",
        (rid, kind, wave or 99, limit))]


def latest_fit(conn, rid: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        """SELECT f.* FROM fit_check f WHERE f.requirement_id = ? AND f.id = (
             SELECT MAX(g.id) FROM fit_check g WHERE g.requirement_id = f.requirement_id
             AND COALESCE(g.vehicle_model_id,'') = COALESCE(f.vehicle_model_id,'')
             AND COALESCE(g.market_code,'') = COALESCE(f.market_code,'') AND g.check_type = f.check_type)
           ORDER BY f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code, f.check_type""", (rid,)).fetchall()
    return [{"target": target_obj(r["vehicle_model_id"], r["market_code"]), "check_type": r["check_type"],
             "result": r["result"], "rationale": r["rationale"], "checked_by": r["checked_by"],
             "checked_at": r["checked_at"]} for r in rows]


def challenges(conn, rid: str) -> list[dict]:
    """PM challenges paired with the AI answers by following event id order: each `challenge` opens an entry, the
    next `challenge_response` before the following `challenge` answers it (an orphan answer gets its own entry)."""
    out: list[dict] = []
    for e in conn.execute("""SELECT id, ts, actor_id, action, new_value, rationale, model FROM audit_event
                             WHERE entity_type = 'requirement' AND entity_id = ?
                             AND action IN ('challenge', 'challenge_response') ORDER BY id""", (rid,)):
        if e["action"] == "challenge":
            out.append({"asked_at": e["ts"], "actor": e["actor_id"], "question": e["rationale"],
                        "answered_at": None, "model": None, "answer": None})
        else:
            ans = loads(e["new_value"], {}) or {}
            answer = {k: ans.get(k) for k in ("verdict", "answer", "evidence_for", "evidence_against",
                                               "proposed_edits", "link_finding_ids")}
            if out and out[-1]["answer"] is None:
                out[-1].update(answered_at=e["ts"], model=e["model"], answer=answer)
            else:
                out.append({"asked_at": None, "actor": None, "question": None, "answered_at": e["ts"],
                            "model": e["model"], "answer": answer})
    return out


@router.get("/requirements/{rid}")
def requirement_detail(rid: str) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        req = require_requirement(conn, rid)
        w = current_wave(conn)
        s = requirement_summary(conn, rid)
        bmap = {(r[0], r[1]): loads(r[2]) for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, score_breakdown_json FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?",
            (rid,))}
        quotes = _quotes(conn, rid, w)
        study = _linked(conn, rid, "study", w, 6)
        web = _linked(conn, rid, "web", w, 6)
        contra = [{"finding_id": r[0], "title": r[1], "source_kind": r[2]} for r in conn.execute(
            """SELECT f.id, f.title, f.source_kind FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id

                FROM finding_source fs JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id WHERE fs.finding_id IN ({ph})
                GROUP BY 1, 2, 3""", ids):
        counts[r[0]].append({"kind": r[1], "market": r[2], "n": r[3], "tier": r[4]})
        n_src[r[0]] += r[3]

                              ids).fetchall())
    mw = metrics_wave(wave)

                "relation": f.get("relation"), "n_sources": n_src.get(f["id"], 0), "n_signals": n_sig.get(f["id"], 0),

def waterfall(b: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Score arithmetic as steps: factor points (without confidence), the confidence cut, modifiers, total."""
    facs = (b or {}).get("factors") or {}
    if not facs:
        return []
    conf = float(b.get("confidence") or 1.0)
    wsum = sum(f["weight"] for f in facs.values() if f.get("available")) or 1
    rows, run = [], 0.0
    for key, f in facs.items():
        if not f.get("available"):
            continue
        pts = 100 * f["weight"] * (f["value"] or 0) / wsum
        rows.append({"step": f["label"], "factor": key, "kind": "factor", "start": round(run, 2),
                     "end": round(run + pts, 2), "delta": round(pts, 2)})
        run += pts
    cut = run * (1 - conf)
    if cut >= 0.05:
        rows.append({"step": f"Evidence confidence ×{conf}", "factor": None, "kind": "minus", "start": round(run - cut, 2),
                     "end": round(run, 2), "delta": round(-cut, 2)})
        run -= cut
    for k, val in (b.get("modifiers") or {}).items():
        if val:
            rows.append({"step": k.replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "factor": None, "kind": "plus" if val > 0 else "minus",
                         "start": round(min(run, run + val), 2), "end": round(max(run, run + val), 2),
                         "delta": round(val, 2)})
            run += val
    rows.append({"step": "Score", "factor": None, "kind": "total", "start": 0, "end": float(b.get("score", run)),
                 "delta": float(b.get("score", run))})
    return rows

@router.patch("/requirements/{rid}")
def edit(rid: str, body: EditBody, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> dict:
    why = need_rationale(body.rationale)
    unknown = sorted(set(body.changes) - set(service.EDITABLE))
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(422, f"Not editable: {', '.join(unknown)} (editable: {', '.join(service.EDITABLE)})")
    for k, v in body.changes.items():
        if v is not None and not isinstance(v, str):
            raise HTTPException(422, f"{k} must be a string or null")
        if k in L.ENUMS and v not in L.ENUMS[k]:
            raise HTTPException(422, f"{k} must be one of {L.ENUMS[k]}")
        if k == "title" and not (v or "").strip():
            raise HTTPException(422, "title must not be empty")
    with db() as conn:
        cur = require_requirement(conn, rid)
        changed = [k for k, v in body.changes.items() if v != cur.get(k)]
        with action_errors():
            version = service.edit_requirement(conn, rid, body.changes, actor, why)
    return {"version": version, "changed": changed}

finding → signal → verbatim chain), quality hand-over list and its logged CSV export."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from fastapi.responses import Response

from api import labels as L
from api.deps import db, get_actor, not_found
from api.queries import current_wave, loads, metrics_wave
from bmw_req import service
from bmw_req.pipeline.requirements import QUALITY_DEFECT_SHARE

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["evidence"])

MK = L.MARKETS
HIDDEN_META = {"price_eur", "price_note"}   # prices are out of scope; never shipped


def _all_findings(conn, mw: str) -> list[dict]:
    n_req = dict(conn.execute("SELECT finding_id, COUNT(*) FROM requirement_finding GROUP BY 1").fetchall())
    n_src = dict(conn.execute("SELECT finding_id, COUNT(*) FROM finding_source GROUP BY 1").fetchall())
    out = []
    for r in conn.execute("""SELECT id, source_kind, type, category, title, summary, vehicle_model_id, market_code,
                                    metrics_json, first_wave, polarity FROM finding ORDER BY id"""):
        mt = loads(r["metrics_json"], {}) or {}
        bw = ((mt.get("by_wave") or {}).get(mw) or {}) if r["source_kind"] == "verbatim" else {}
        bym = bw.get("markets") or {}
        out.append({
            "id": r["id"], "source_kind": r["source_kind"], "type": r["type"], "category": r["category"],
            "title": r["title"], "summary": r["summary"], "vehicle": r["vehicle_model_id"], "market": r["market_code"],
            "polarity": r["polarity"], "first_wave": r["first_wave"],
            "scope": f"{r['vehicle_model_id'] or 'line'} × {r['market_code'] or 'all'}",
            "verbatims": int(bw.get("verbatims") or 0),
            "by_market": {m: int((bym.get(m) or {}).get("verbatims") or 0) for m in MK},
            "n_sources": n_src.get(r["id"], 0), "n_requirements": n_req.get(r["id"], 0),
        })
    return out


@router.get("/findings")
def findings(vehicle: str | None = Query(None, description="derivative, or 'line' for line-level findings"),
             market: str | None = None, kind: str | None = None, category: str | None = None,
             type: str | None = None, q: str | None = None, uncovered: bool = False, visible_only: bool = True,
             limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=2000), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0)) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        w = current_wave(conn)
        mw = metrics_wave(w)
        items = _all_findings(conn, mw)
    sel = items
    if vehicle:
        sel = [f for f in sel if (f["vehicle"] is None if vehicle == "line" else f["vehicle"] == vehicle)]
    if market:
        sel = [f for f in sel if f["market"] == market or f["by_market"].get(market, 0) > 0]
    if kind:
        sel = [f for f in sel if f["source_kind"] == kind]
    if category:
        sel = [f for f in sel if f["category"] == category]
    if type:
        sel = [f for f in sel if f["type"] == type]
    if q:
        ql = q.lower()
        sel = [f for f in sel if ql in (f["title"] or "").lower() or ql in (f["summary"] or "").lower()]
    if visible_only and w:
        sel = [f for f in sel if (f["first_wave"] or 1) <= w]
    used = sum(f["n_requirements"] > 0 for f in sel)
    total_unfiltered_unc = len(sel) - used
    if uncovered:
        sel = [f for f in sel if f["n_requirements"] == 0]
    sel.sort(key=lambda f: (-f["verbatims"], -f["n_sources"], f["id"]))
    return {"total": len(sel), "used": used, "uncovered": total_unfiltered_unc, "metrics_wave": mw,
            "items": sel[offset: offset + limit]}


@router.get("/findings/{fid}")
def finding(fid: int) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        r = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM finding WHERE id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone()
        if r is None:
            raise not_found(f"No finding F{fid}")
        used = [dict(x) for x in conn.execute(
            """SELECT r.id AS req_id, r.title, r.status, rf.relation FROM requirement_finding rf
               JOIN requirement r ON r.id = rf.requirement_id WHERE rf.finding_id = ? ORDER BY r.id""", (fid,))]
        n_src = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_source WHERE finding_id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone()[0]
        n_sig = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_signal WHERE finding_id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone()[0]
        mw = metrics_wave(current_wave(conn))
    f = dict(r)
    metrics = loads(f.pop("metrics_json", None), {}) or {}
    out = {**f, "vehicle": f["vehicle_model_id"], "market": f["market_code"], "metrics": metrics,
           "n_sources": n_src, "n_signals": n_sig, "used_by": used, "metrics_wave": mw}
    if f.get("source_kind") == "verbatim":
        out["markets"] = ((metrics.get("by_wave") or {}).get(mw) or {}).get("markets") or {}
    return out


def _meta(s) -> dict:
    meta = loads(s, {}) or {}
    return {k: v for k, v in meta.items() if k not in HIDDEN_META} if isinstance(meta, dict) else {}


@router.get("/findings/{fid}/sources")
def finding_sources(fid: int, limit: int = Query(30, ge=1, le=500), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0)) -> list[dict]:
    with db() as conn:
        if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM finding WHERE id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone() is None:
            raise not_found(f"No finding F{fid}")
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT s.id, s.kind, s.external_id, s.ref, s.country, s.market_code, s.vehicle_model_id, s.url,
                      s.published_at, s.retrieved_at, s.trust_tier, s.wave, s.text, s.meta_json,
                      COALESCE(fs.quote, s.quote) AS quote, fs.relation
               FROM finding_source fs JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id WHERE fs.finding_id = ?
               ORDER BY s.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?""", (fid, limit, offset)).fetchall()
    return [{"id": r["id"], "kind": r["kind"], "external_id": r["external_id"], "ref": r["ref"], "country": r["country"],
             "market": r["market_code"], "vehicle": r["vehicle_model_id"], "url": r["url"],
             "published_at": r["published_at"], "retrieved_at": r["retrieved_at"], "trust_tier": r["trust_tier"],
             "wave": r["wave"], "relation": r["relation"], "quote": r["quote"], "text": r["text"],
             "meta": _meta(r["meta_json"])} for r in rows]


@router.get("/findings/{fid}/signals")
def finding_signals(fid: int, limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=1000), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0)) -> list[dict]:
    with db() as conn:
        if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM finding WHERE id = ?", (fid,)).fetchone() is None:
            raise not_found(f"No finding F{fid}")
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT g.id, g.feedback_type, g.severity, g.category, g.topic, g.need_statement, g.quote, g.quote_verified,
                      g.support_question, g.extractor_version, s.id sid, s.external_id, s.market_code, s.country,
                      s.vehicle_model_id, s.wave, json_extract(s.meta_json, '$.channel') channel
               FROM finding_signal fs JOIN signal g ON g.id = fs.signal_id JOIN source_item s ON s.id = g.source_item_id
               WHERE fs.finding_id = ?
               ORDER BY CASE g.severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, g.quote_verified DESC, g.id
               LIMIT ? OFFSET ?""", (fid, limit, offset)).fetchall()
    return [{"signal_id": r["id"], "feedback_type": r["feedback_type"], "severity": r["severity"],
             "category": r["category"], "topic": r["topic"], "need_statement": r["need_statement"], "quote": r["quote"],
             "quote_verified": bool(r["quote_verified"]), "support_question": bool(r["support_question"]),
             "extractor_version": r["extractor_version"],
             "source": {"id": r["sid"], "external_id": r["external_id"], "market": r["market_code"],
                        "country": r["country"], "vehicle": r["vehicle_model_id"], "channel": r["channel"],
                        "wave": r["wave"]}} for r in rows]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ quality hand-over
def _quality(conn, vehicle: str | None, category: str | None, quotes: bool = True) -> dict:
    mw = metrics_wave(current_wave(conn))
    rows = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT f.id, f.vehicle_model_id, f.category, f.title, f.summary, f.metrics_json, COUNT(*) n_signals,
                  AVG(g.feedback_type = 'defect') defect_share, SUM(g.severity = 'high') n_high,
                  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(rf.requirement_id) FROM requirement_finding rf
                    WHERE rf.finding_id = f.id AND rf.relation = 'supports') reqs
           FROM finding f JOIN finding_signal fs ON fs.finding_id = f.id JOIN signal g ON g.id = fs.signal_id
           WHERE f.source_kind = 'verbatim' AND COALESCE(f.polarity, '') != 'like'
           GROUP BY f.id HAVING defect_share >= ? ORDER BY n_signals DESC""", (QUALITY_DEFECT_SHARE,))]
    if vehicle:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r["vehicle_model_id"] == vehicle]
    if category:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r["category"] == category]
    items = []
    for r in rows:
        mk = ((loads(r["metrics_json"], {}) or {}).get("by_wave", {}).get(mw, {}) or {}).get("markets", {}) or {}
        item = {"finding_id": r["id"], "vehicle": r["vehicle_model_id"], "car": L.car(r["vehicle_model_id"]),
                "category": r["category"], "title": r["title"], "summary": r["summary"], "n_signals": r["n_signals"],
                "defect_share": round(r["defect_share"], 4), "n_high": int(r["n_high"] or 0),
                "markets": {k: (v or {}).get("verbatims") for k, v in
                            sorted(mk.items(), key=lambda kv: -((kv[1] or {}).get("verbatims") or 0))},
                "cited_by": sorted((r["reqs"] or "").split(",")) if r["reqs"] else []}
        if quotes:
            item["quotes"] = [dict(x) for x in conn.execute(
                """SELECT s.external_id, s.market_code AS market, g.quote FROM finding_signal fs
                   JOIN signal g ON g.id = fs.signal_id JOIN source_item s ON s.id = g.source_item_id
                   WHERE fs.finding_id = ? AND g.feedback_type = 'defect' AND g.quote_verified = 1
                   ORDER BY CASE g.severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.id LIMIT 4""", (r["id"],))]
        items.append(item)
    return {"n_issues": len(items), "n_signals": sum(i["n_signals"] for i in items),
            "n_high": sum(i["n_high"] for i in items), "n_cited": sum(bool(i["cited_by"]) for i in items),
            "defect_share_min": QUALITY_DEFECT_SHARE, "metrics_wave": mw, "items": items}


@router.get("/quality")
def quality(vehicle: str | None = None, category: str | None = None) -> dict:
    with db() as conn:
        return _quality(conn, vehicle, category)


@router.get("/quality.csv")
def quality_csv(vehicle: str | None = None, category: str | None = None, actor: str = Depends(get_actor)) -> Response:
    with db() as conn:
        data = _quality(conn, vehicle, category, quotes=False)
        buf = io.StringIO()
        w = csv.writer(buf)
        w.writerow(["theme", "car", "category", "signals", "defect share", "high severity", "markets", "cited by"])
        for i in data["items"]:
            w.writerow([i["title"], i["car"], i["category"], i["n_signals"], i["defect_share"], i["n_high"],
                        ", ".join(f"{L.mkt(k)} {v}" for k, v in i["markets"].items()), ", ".join(i["cited_by"]) or "–"])
        flt = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in (("vehicle", vehicle), ("category", category)) if v) or "none"
        # fixes the Streamlit gap: this export is now an access event like every other download
        service.log_access(conn, actor, "export", "export", "quality_handover.csv",
                           f"{len(data['items'])} rows; filters: {flt}")
    return Response(buf.getvalue(), media_type="text/csv; charset=utf-8",
                    headers={"Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="quality_handover.csv"'})
